title: Randomized and Exchangeable Improvements of Markov's, Chebyshev's and Chernoff's Inequalities

split.decision: Frozen Beta(20,b) generator; no cross-instance training. Public validation seed 20261030, 50 alternative and 500 null replications per cell; full hidden evaluation with 500 replications per cell. Observations only, shuffled SHA256-hashed opaque IDs; independently drawn secret data seeds are recorded only in operator artifacts. Algorithm streams use BENCH_SEED and opaque IDs; original reset/shuffle schedule retained. See NOTES for original archive parity and seed separation.

baseline.paper_ref: Sec.9.4/Fig.5: reproduced UMI power 0.4718; 0.13554 is a distinct Sec.9.1 interval-width metric and is not the power target.

allowed_changes: Any stateful predictable bet selector, prefix-based working model, learned parameters and auxiliary loss may replace LBOW/predmix.
Global permutation count and admissible mixture/clipping configuration may be chosen before private observations, within the fixed capital construction.

When retaining the supplied betting_interface.DEFAULT pipeline, changing only B=100, positive="lbow", negative="predmix", theta=0.5, trunc_scale=0.5 or combine="max" does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve power of the fixed bounded-mean test constructed from permutation-averaged predictable betting capital and randomized Markov rejection.
The null E[X]=1/2 for bounded iid observations, supplied sequences, alpha=.05, trusted capital recursion and final randomized Markov rule remain fixed.
Bet-before-observation predictability, known horizon n, fresh state per permutation, same permutation/U schedule and all per-n/pooled type-I thresholds remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.

forbidden_substitutions: Do not substitute a parametric Beta-only null or generic p-value classifier, self-report e-values/decisions, change the capital arithmetic or condition bets on future observations.
